EXECUTIVE BRIEF — Wed Aug 5, 2:42 PM ET | Target $150K/month

MONEY ON THE TABLE — $105,080 (70% of monthly target) in two signatures
1. TERRA LOTUS - $78,580 - STILL UNSENT, DAY 3. 19,000 units. Deposit $39,290 / balance $39,290. Contract rebuilt on the unified template, Articles 1-13 clean. Blocked only on your review. This is the single largest revenue item in the business right now.
2. ATLAS ETERNAL - $26,500 - You reported it sent to Ryne Bell's WhatsApp today. Open: countersignature + $13,250 deposit not yet confirmed, and the pro forma still carries 3 placeholders (fill size/packaging, billing address, lead time/Incoterms).

NEEDS YOU TODAY
- Terra Lotus: approve and I send tonight.
- Atlas: confirm which document version went out so I mark the CRM task complete only against confirmed delivery, not intent.

MOVED
- OpenSend session rescheduled to tomorrow 12:00 PM ET. Still pending: 3 lookalike domains (~$45/yr), sending platform (~$40/mo), Outbound Agent creation, booking calendar URL, ICP Tier A sign-off. Warmup is 2-3 weeks and cannot be compressed - every day of delay pushes first cold reply into late August.

AIDAN WORKSPACE - BUILT, AWAITING YOUR ACCOUNT ACTIONS
Three agent briefs, Signal vs Noise protocol, and a separate Command Center (18/18 checks green, isolated switchboard, cannot dispatch to your agents) are ready. I cannot create workspaces, agents, or connections - those are yours. Need: Aidan's email, his WhatsApp scanned from his phone, 3 separate CRM logins, and one decision: do his agents see customer pricing and margins, or supplier-side costs only? My recommendation is supplier-side only.

RISK - REVENUE LEAK WHILE ADS SPEND
Homepage quote form reportedly drops submissions and Contact Us routes away from you while paid traffic runs. Last 7-day ad spend $201.88 vs $128.52 prior (+57%) with CTR down 16.4% to 13.9%. Cap is held pending attribution. Paying for clicks into a leaking form is the worst dollar in the business.

RANKED PRIORITIES
1. Approve Terra Lotus ($78,580)
2. Confirm Atlas delivery + fill 3 pro forma placeholders ($26,500)
3. Start Aidan's workspace shell so I can wire his board
4. Shopify access so I can fix the form leak
5. Tomorrow noon: OpenSend green-lights
spoken_text: Sam, here's the bottom line. Two signatures are worth a hundred five thousand dollars, which is about seventy percent of your monthly target. Terra Lotus is seventy eight thousand five hundred eighty and it has now sat unsent for three days, blocked only on your review. Atlas Eternal is twenty six thousand five hundred and you told me it went to Ryne today, but I have no confirmed countersignature or deposit yet. The Aidan workspace is built as far as I can take it. The briefs, the accountability protocol, and his own separate command board are done and tested, but creating the workspace and the connections is yours, not mine. OpenSend moved to tomorrow at noon, and the two to three week warmup means every delay pushes your first cold reply toward late August. One thing worries me. We are increasing ad spend while the website form may be dropping leads. My recommendation is simple. Approve Terra Lotus today. It is the single biggest number in the business and it is waiting on one decision.
